Interface PbcsJobDefinition

  • Method Details

    • getJobType

      PbcsJobType getJobType()
      The job type, such as Cube Refresh or Rules. Note: not all job types are currently mapped in to the job type enumeration. A full list can be found here: ....

      If you need to check for a type that is not currently mapped in to the enumeration, then use the getOriginalJobType() method and check the string manually.

      Returns:
      the job type (if known and mapped), otherwise the type PbcsJobType.OTHER.

    • getOriginalJobType

      String getOriginalJobType()
      Gets the original job type string description. Use when/if the type you need isn't currently modeled in the type enumeration.
      Returns:
      the original job type from the server

    • getPlanTypeName

      String getPlanTypeName()
      Gets the plan type name that this job is specific to, null if none (such as the Cube Refresh job)
      Returns:
      the plan type name, null if none

    • getParent

      PbcsApplication getParent()
      Description copied from interface: PbcsObject
      Returns the parent of this object, which may be another member, plan, application, client, or null if there is no logical parent. Interfaces that extend this one provide covariant return types that are more specific than a PbcsObject. For example, a plan will return its application as a parent.
      Specified by:
      getParent in interface PbcsObject
      Returns:
      the parent of this object
